title: Catalytic performance of electronic waste-derived gold nanoparticles for the reduction of p-nitrophenol
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,1638-1656
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN01077A, Paper
Michelle Y. Lau, David C. Young, Jack L.-Y. Chen, Jonathan Sperry
Gold nanoparticles synthesised from low concentration e-waste leachate solutions display superior catalytic performance for the reduction of p-nitrophenol compared to gold nanoparticles derived from highly refined sources.
